about_the_game:
Core Experience

Master the art of precision combat in this action arcade game where split-second decisions determine your destiny.


Chain strike attacks to build powerful combos while navigating through a liminal landscape of danger and beauty.


Unlock various audio mix tapes and trail tails by gaining a huge score bank, combo, or winning an achievement.

Key Features

🔸 4-Player Co-Op Team Experience

Revive your fallen buddies by defeating a powerful boss

Earn the ultimate high score together on the same screen

Discover why group synergy makes all the difference

🔸 Hypnotic Combat System

Fluid, responsive controls that feel natural from the first moment

Progressive combo system rewarding skillful play with up to 10x score multipliers

Strategic dash mechanics that transform simple inputs into complex battle choreography

🔸 Competitive Edge

Global leaderboards to prove your mastery

Challenge the high score in single and team modes to test your skill

Go on a thrilling journey towards unlocking your potential

Demo vs. Full Game Content

Synergy Strike Demo provides a focused preview experience that includes:

Customization Content:

6 unlockable tail trail customizations (vs. 30 in full game)

7 unlockable mix tape music tracks (vs. 20 in full game with playlisting features)

Multiplayer & Modes:

1-4 player cooperative team modes

Solo play mode

Basic online and local leaderboards

Core Gameplay:

Full hypnotic combat system with combo mechanics

HDR support and aspect ratio compatibility

All control options (keyboard, gamepad, Steam Deck touch)

Perfect For

Arcade enthusiasts seeking their next addiction

Score-chasers hungry for leaderboard dominance

Players looking for quick, intense gaming sessions

Technical Details

Simple Controls With Endless Replay-Ability

Supports Keyboard, Gamepad, Steam-Deck Touch

HDR Support, Aspect Ratios From 1:1 To Ultra-Wide

Controls

Arrow Keys / Gamepad Controller: Navigate the arena with fluid precision

Space Bar / South Controller Button: Execute devastating dash strike attacks

ESC Key / Pause: Freeze time and take a moment of respite

⚡Surge into Synergy Strike where every run is a chance to achieve valor, every combo builds your legend, and every play session pulls you deeper into a world of geometric action.

The Full Game expands this experience significantly with:

Enhanced Customization:

30 total unlockable tail trails (5x more variety)

20 unlockable mix tape tracks with full playlisting functionality

Complete visual and audio personalization options

Expanded Multiplayer:

All demo cooperative modes PLUS 1-4 player Versus modes

Steam-integrated online multiplayer

Enhanced leaderboard system with improved Steam integration

Competitive ranking and matchmaking

Vastly More Content:

15 additional enemy types beyond the demo

5 more elite enemy variants for increased challenge

8 additional boss encounters

Expanded background art variety for visual diversity

Full Steam achievements integration

Technical Improvements:

Advanced online systems through Steam integration

Improved local leaderboard functionality

Enhanced multiplayer networking and connectivity

This demo offers approximately 20-25% of the full game's content, focusing on the core combat mechanics and cooperative gameplay to showcase the essential Synergy Strike experience.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS Version: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (proprietary driver 535+), AMD Radeon RX 470 (Mesa 23+), or Intel Arc A380; Vulkan-capable GPU with 2–4 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: none
  • Additional Notes: Native Linux Build

short_description: Arcade game where you play as triangles that dash strike enemies. Enter the flow state to climb global leaderboards while earning massive combos. Up to 4 friends can join in synergy with couch co-op team mode. Unlock prizes using your precision, poise, and persistence as 2D colorful combat ignites.
